title: Firmwares
description: Firmwares - flash an XPRS board over USB, then set it up: claim it, put it on your WiFi, name it, and read how it is doing.
summary: Plug a board in over USB (an OTG cable on the phone) and this app writes an XPRS firmware from xprs.dev to it: it recognises the chip, suggests the right image, downloads it and flashes it, verified. A freshly flashed station then asks, over Bluetooth, to be claimed. This app notices it and sets it up from your phone: it becomes yours, joins your WiFi with the password sealed to its key so nobody nearby can read it, takes a name and a time zone, keeps or changes its identity, and reports its firmware, uptime and memory. Boards without Bluetooth are set up the same way from their own WiFi hotspot.
